subject: 🏠 You have been moved to a new room - $new_building_name, Room $new_room_number
body:
Dear $student_name,

We are writing to let you know that your university accommodation has changed. $relocation_reason

You did not need to do anything to arrange this — we have already moved your booking to another room for you, and your tenancy continues without interruption.

=== YOUR NEW ACCOMMODATION ===
Building: $new_building_name
Room Number: $new_room_number
Floor Number: $new_floor_number
Room Type: $new_room_type
Building Address: $new_building_address
Campus: $new_campus_location

=== YOUR PREVIOUS ACCOMMODATION ===
Building: $old_building_name
Room Number: $old_room_number
Floor Number: $old_floor_number

=== YOUR TENANCY ===
Assignment Reference: $assignment_id
Contract Number: $contract_number
Monthly Rent: £$monthly_rent (unchanged)
Move-In Date: $move_in_date
Planned Move-Out Date: $move_out_date
Relocated On: $relocation_date

Your rent, contract number and contract dates are unchanged. You will not be charged anything extra as a result of this move.

=== WHAT YOU NEED TO DO ===

1. COLLECT YOUR NEW KEY
   - Please visit the Housing Office to exchange your old key or access card for the new one before moving your belongings.

2. MOVE YOUR BELONGINGS
   - Please move your belongings to $new_building_name, Room $new_room_number (Floor $new_floor_number) as soon as possible.
   - If you need help moving, contact the Housing Office and we will arrange assistance.

3. UPDATE YOUR ADDRESS
   - Update your term-time address in the Student Portal so post reaches you.

4. CHECK YOUR NEW ROOM
   - Complete the move-in inventory checklist for your new room within 7 days so you are not held responsible for any pre-existing damage.

=== IF THIS DOES NOT WORK FOR YOU ===
If your new room does not meet your accessibility, medical or other agreed requirements, please contact the Housing Office straight away and we will look at the alternatives available.

=== CONTACT INFORMATION ===
Housing Office: housing@university.edu
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM

We are sorry for the disruption and thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
University Housing Administration

$signature
